references.notes: Glasshouse floor gully: flagstones and a low stone kerb, an open cast-iron grating, brick sump with standing water, downpipe shoe and low side outlet. The form and all dimensions beyond the brief are design assumptions, not surveyed atlas dimensions.

review.seen: iso beauty and clay, opposite, front and top renders
review.weak: The grate is a simple barred casting, not a documented foundry pattern; the fabricated shoe is an S-bend through the grate, rather than a surveyed pattern, and water is difficult to see from low views.
improve: Develop a documented period grate and maker's inscription [brief]
Model a genuinely watertight pipe-to-masonry connection [review]
